title: Japan Travel Smart
author: Travel Smart Productions
description: Japan Travel Smart is a biweekly podcast all about the joy of travel through Japan far and wide, from the perspective of a frequent traveler who just can’t get enough of the place that does it best.

episodes_recents.titre: More than a city: Introducing the prefecture of Kyoto (No AI)

Forget Mt. Fuji: Climbing a mountain elsewhere in Japan
The two most sacred locations in Japan—visited back-to-back
Profound solitude: Traveling solo in Japan (and other assorted thoughts)
